caption: The drawing features a detailed, central graphite illustration of a tankard with a domed lid, a prominent curved handle, and a slightly flared base. The tankard is rendered in grayscale shades, with shading indicating its cylindrical form and metallic texture. The handle is ornate, incorporating multiple curves and a decorative element at the top near the hinge of the lid. Around the central tankard, four smaller technical views are arranged in the corners: the upper left shows detailed profiles of the handle and a section; the upper right is a side profile of the tankard; the lower left displays a top-down sectional view; the lower right gives a front elevation of the tankard with dimensional annotations. The background is a uniform off-white or light beige color, and thin, precise lines are used for all elements, including measurement indicators. The central drawing is labeled “MEYERS,” and a scale labeled “Scale ½” is included below the main image for dimensional reference.
title: Pewter Tankard
